The `delphi`, `nominal-group` and `group-cognition` panel steps that must not see each other run blind. Check readiness with the `confinement-blind-read` row of `fgos doctor`. Details: `docs/specs/confinement-authority.md` §9.2.

The `delphi`, `nominal-group` and `group-cognition` panel steps that must not see each other run blind. Check readiness with the `confinement-blind-read` row of `fgos doctor`.
